_note: Curated reading paths across books (review F21), shown on the hub. Hand-authored seeds from the design review; Lane adjusts, adds, removes. Each step is a reference plus one line on why it's on the path. `arc` is one of arcs.json's ids.

paths.label: The land
paths.note: The promise of land, from the call of Abram to the gentle who inherit the earth.

steps.note: the land shown to Abram, promised to his seed
the land divided as an inheritance, by lot and by size
go in and take possession of what was sworn
every place the sole of your foot treads
the gentle will inherit the earth

paths.label: Be strong
paths.note: The commissioning charge, and the presence that grounds it.

steps.note: be strong and firm; he will not leave you
the charge repeated three times, with 'I will be with you'
be strong, all the people of the land, for I am with you
the commission, and 'I am with you always'
stand firm in the faith, be strong
